description:
A greatsword, a.k.a. a two-handed sword.  This is a half-dragon variant, which is heavier yet still meant to be swung swiftly in a whirlwind, thanks to half-dragon
muscle and reflexes.  It is NOT balanced or weighted properly for pure-blooded human use.
name: Iron Half-Dragon Greatsword

description: A pure-blood human-style sword, that takes one hand to use, leaving a shield an option.
name: Iron Longsword

description: A two-handed axe with double blades, that can cut deep.  This type is made for pure-blooded human use.
name: Iron Battleaxe

description: A one-handed combat axe, which allows the other hand to hold a shield.
name: Iron Hand Axe

description:
A spell-caster's staff, which one can swing hard at someone to really bean them in the head.  It also sometimes
facilitates extra magics.
name: Iron Staff

description:
A matched set of pure-blood human-style swords, one for each hand.  Takes skill and expertise to use, that not all character classes have.
Doesn't leave a shield as an option for people with only two hands, such as humans, zarakites, etc.  As for freaks or mutants, um, whatever...
name: Iron Dual Longswords

description: A matched set of one-handed combat axes.
name: Iron Dual Axes

description: A pure-blood human-style sword, that takes one hand to use, leaving a shield an option.
name: Iron Katana

description:
A pure-blood human-style sword, that takes one hand to use, leaving a shield an option.
This is a ninja sword, and looks similar to a katana but with a straight instead of curved blade.
name: Iron Ninjato

A matched set of pure-blood human-style swords, one for each hand.  Takes skill and expertise to use, that not all character classes have.
Doesn't leave a shield as an option for people with only two hands, such as humans, zarakites, etc.  As for freaks or mutants, um, whatever...
name: Copper Lightning Dual Longswords

description: A matched set of one-handed combat axes.
name: Copper Lightning Dual Axes

description: A pure-blood human-style sword, that takes one hand to use, leaving a shield an option.
name: Copper Lightning Katana

description:
A pure-blood human-style sword, that takes one hand to use, leaving a shield an option.
This is a ninja sword, and looks similar to a katana but with a straight instead of curved blade.
name: Copper Lightning Ninjato

description:
A greatsword, a.k.a. a two-handed sword.  This is a half-dragon variant, which is heavier yet still meant to be swung swiftly in a whirlwind, thanks to half-dragon
muscle and reflexes.  It is NOT balanced or weighted properly for pure-blooded human use.
name: Bronze Lightning Greatsword

description: A pure-blood human-style sword, that takes one hand to use, leaving a shield an option.
name: Bronze Lightning Longsword

description: A two-handed axe with double blades, that can cut deep.  This type is made for pure-blooded human use.
name: Bronze Lightning Battleaxe

description: A one-handed combat axe, which allows the other hand to hold a shield.
name: Bronze Lightning Hand Axe

description:
A spell-caster's staff, usable by more than one character class, which one can swing hard at someone to really bean them in the head.  It also sometimes
facilitates extra magics.
